The '''KL-9Z-SE''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Korrealis Systems]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The KL-9Z-SE is a Imperial-only mount in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that was added in Game Update 2.7, where it is a rare item dropped by bosses of the Assault on Tython flashpoint.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
